item.title: Queen’s Domain Review: The Perfect Skyrim Replacement for Right Now
item.description: I love Skyrim . I love returning to the spine-tingling haze of ’90s first-person games like Doom , Quake , and Myst . But what I really love is a modern game that feels like a lost relic from that era, not a nostalgic imitation but something that might have actually existed.

item.title: Legend of Zelda Officially Returns to The Wilds Era in December
item.description: All eyes are on The Legend of Zelda right now — and for good reason. The franchise is currently in the midst of celebrating its 40th anniversary and the long-awaited remake of Ocarina of Time was released on Nov. 5, 2026, becoming the second best-selling game on the Nintendo Switch 2 less than a week after its release. But, even amid all the Ocarina excitement, it's hard to forget just how memorable earlier Switch-era Zelda titles were — particularly Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom.

item.title: Netflix's Hit Spy Thriller Returns and Takes Over Streaming Charts
item.description: Keira Knightley has a knack for playing smart, determined women who refuse to back down when things get dangerous. Whether she's exposing government secrets in Official Secrets , investigating a serial killer in Boston Strangler , or navigating a deadly mystery aboard a luxury yacht in Netflix's The Woman in Cabin 10 , Knightley has become a natural fit for tense thrillers.

item.title: New 'GTA 6' Gameplay Leaves Fans Stunned
item.description: With only a week left before the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , there's little in Rockstar Games' marketing that players haven't seen before. That familiarity is true of new GTA 6 features, at least. In terms of visuals, the game developer just proved it still has plenty of Leonida to show off.

item.title: All Bomb Bag upgrade locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: You can upgrade your Bomb Bag in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, allowing you to carry more bombs and make more enemies explode. While not required to beat the game, if you want to be able to fling bombs freely, you should definitely upgrade your Bomb Bags and max out their capacity.

item.title: Diablo Meets Hades in New Conan the Barbarian Game
item.description: Conan the Barbarian has managed to remain relevant in pop culture for more than 90 years, thanks to literature , film , and video games . In 2028, Conan will return in a new adventure that combines the fantasy franchise's sword-and-sworcery themes with a dash of cosmic horror.

item.title: How to get the Goron Tunic in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Goron Tunic is a unique piece of equipment that allows Link to withstand high temperatures in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. If you try to explore the Death Mountain Crater without this item, Link's clothes will catch fire, and he will start losing health. While entering such a dangerous place might not sound like a good idea, you can't actually avoid it, as you'll need to traverse the area to reach the Fire Temple during the story.

item.title: All Deku-Seed Bag upgrade locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Deku-Seed Bag upgrades are a must in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, if you want to be able to beam your opponents from afar without worrying about running out of seeds. Not to be confused with the Deku-Nut Bag , which holds the nuts you can use to flash-stun enemies, the Deku-Seed Bag holds ammo for your Fairy Slingshot.

item.title: All Deku-Nut Bag upgrade locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: Upgrading Link's Deku-Nut Bag increases the number of flashy nuts that you carry in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. As young Link, Deku nuts are extremely useful items, as they stun enemies and create the perfect moment to attack. Unfortunately, you can carry a limited number of nuts early in the game. However, if you know where to look — and which holes to jump into — you can find bigger bags to carry more nuts.
